text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm walking down the
hallway...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for lending me your English
textbook, Chiyo. I really have to stop
sleeping past my
alarm. I keep
forgetting things.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's no problem. You're always helping
me out
too!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Come on, I feel like I'm asking way more
from you than you do from me. I had to
borrow something
from you just the
other day too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...I've really gotta get it together.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oops, it's time for the next class... Sigh. Well, see you later.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Okay! See you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ahh! Oh, Trainer, it's you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
So, um... you know how City has a job on
top of
everything?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Well, she's been having trouble getting
up in the
morning because her days are
so busy.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
She seems even more tired than usual
lately, and
I'm a little worried about her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If only there were something I could do
to help...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I understand Sakura Chiyono O's feelings, but there's not much she can do about Gold City's work. Although... if there's one thing she can do...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
A present... Ooh, that's a good idea! But
what
should I get her?
choice_data_list: How about giving them a gift that'...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I know! Just the other day, I saw some
fresh duds
that can make anyone feel
totally radical!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
There was this dress that would be
perfect for
dancing! Oh, and a really
smart and
mature-looking suit!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I don't think either would suit me, but
I'm positive
a model like City can pull
off both looks without
a hitch!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can see how excited she is, but it won't
do for her to spend all her money
getting both outfits. I
should help her
narrow down her gift options.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Just the dress?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that makes sense! It's not her
birthday or
anything, so it'd be weird to
randomly give her so
many gifts. Haha!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'll follow your suggestion and
give it to her
tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, I spot Sakura Chiyono O
giving
Gold City her gift. She really
wastes no time.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I had no idea you were so worried
about me.
Thanks for this. Can I open it
now?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold City reaches into the paper bag
and pulls
out...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Is this a bodycon dress?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yep! My role model told me all about
bodycon
dresses!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, they're perfect for dancing
in, and
wearing one is sure to get
anyone feeling super
fly!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Uh... "super fly"?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Super fly and totally radical!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Pfft! Ahaha! You know what, thanks. This
really
cheered me up.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Really? That's great!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, I see Sakura Chiyono O
reporting
everything to her role model,
Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: So I should get just the suit?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That's a good idea. It's not her birthday
or
anything, so it'd be weird to randomly
give her so
many gifts, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Okay! I'll go buy it today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later that night...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Chiyo. I got the present and letter you
put on the
doorknob for me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh! Really?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Sorry for worrying you. Thank you. And...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: H-huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Oh. Sorry. The gift you got me is just so
like you.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
A power suit with extra-large shoulder
pads, huh? I love it. Just looking at it
cheers me up, and the
matcha green
color you chose is really cute.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That's great to hear! My role model was
the one
who told me that matcha green
is a really popular
color right now!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
She also told me you should wear it
when you want to make an impression,
'cause it'll make you
feel super fly and
totally radical!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah? Then maybe I'll wear it to my next

interview.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The following month, Gold City wears
her suit with the prominent shoulder
padding on TV, and
it stirs up quite a
buzz.
